sloka: तत्र स्थाप्य बलं सर्वं नदीतीरे समाहितः ।अग्रतो धनुषा सार्धं गच्छ त्वं लघुविक्रमः ।। ७.६४.१२ ॥
transliteration: tatra sthāpya balaṁ sarvaṁ nadītīre samāhitaḥ ।agrato dhanuṣā sārdhaṁ gaccha tvaṁ laghuvikramaḥ ।। 7.64.12 ॥

translations.english: Having stationed your entire army on the river bank, you, swift in action, should proceed ahead with your bow.
